paragraphs: We recommend disinvesting the joint GIA. We recommend using the gross proceeds of {fact:action.a1.amount} to fund both Robert's and Jean's ISAs for the new tax year. This figure is gross before any CGT and becomes available once the disposal completes. The {fact:money.m2.amount} will be used together with these proceeds to fund both ISAs.
{fact:money.available} is the money available to invest now. We recommend opening a new jointly-held investment account for the balance.
